name: smwgraphics-factory-castle
title: Factory / Castle
description:
This took a long time to draw. Here's what I did and followed the moderator's suggestions:

-changed the name of this tileset to an appropiate one;
-all the big barrels act like tile 100 above and tile 25 below and all small barrels act like tile 100;
-horizontal and vertical lasers animate now. I wanted to make them stationary, but that didn't work;
-'hill tripping' is removed now;
-fixed scrolling settings;
-added the moderator's color suggestion and re-organized the BG a bit;

-removed the white sparkles on the BG windows. Some SNES games kept those, but yeah did the change;
-layer 3 BG has been reworked now. Original clouds have been added, some inspiration from SMB3 and the lightning is way better.

If you do use the lightning, then make a custom block with it.

Use it with a custom status bar patch like the Minimalist Status Bar or the Super Mario Bros. 3 Status Bar for better results, since using with the SMW vanilla status bar causes cutoff in the layer 3.

Give credit, if used.
